travellers.name: Meera (wheelchair user)
travellers.story: Arrives at the international airport for a conference at Jio World Centre. Needs step-free routes only.
travellers.demo_hook: Lift-out reports at BKC Metro 3 (E_BKC_LIFT) -> routed around even though only 'possible'

travellers.name: Rohan (tight-budget student)
travellers.story: Student going from Ghatkopar to a class in Bandra. Very tight budget, prefers metro/local.
travellers.demo_hook: Fake 'Metro 1 shut' burst at 16:40 must NOT reroute him; real Metro 1 issue confirmed at 17:12 DOES

travellers.name: Arjun (strict deadline)
travellers.story: Going from Thane to Wankhede for a 7 PM match; must be inside by 18:30.
travellers.demo_hook: Dadar FOB closure (E_DADAR_FOB) confirmed 17:15 -> replan to fast local to CSMT + taxi

travellers.name: The Kulkarni family (tourists, multi-stop day)
travellers.story: First visit to Mumbai, staying near CSMT. Want a South Mumbai afternoon ending at Marine Drive for sunset.
travellers.demo_hook: Possible waterlogging near Azad Maidan (E_AZAD_WATER, 40%) -> warning on walking legs, plan kept

travellers.name: Priya (refuses autos)
travellers.story: Office in Andheri, meeting at Phoenix Palladium. Won't take autos; ok with local, metro, bus, cab.
travellers.demo_hook: WR slow delay at Andheri (E_ANDHERI_DELAY) + exaggerated 'WR fully band' report that official notice contradicts
